blocks.x: So, anyway, you listened a lot of times like to the classic women blues singers.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
But did ever aspire to becoming a blues singer yourself?

The only person that I wanted to sing like was Ethel Waters. But I never sang blues, per se, I mean I was more concerned about singing what the currently popular tunes were. I don't know what year it was, it must have been in the '20s, one of my uncles, one of my father's brothers, he put together a little radio set, a little wireless and he used to be able to pick up quite a bit of music --
